name: Cetaphil Face Wash Gentle Skin Cleanser for Dry to Normal Skin 125ml (International)
description:
Designed for dry to normal sensitive skin, Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser gently removes dirt, makeup, and impurities while protecting the skin’s natural moisture barrier. Its hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic formula is free from parabens, sulphates, fragrances, and oils, making it safe for daily use.

Key Features:

Gentle Cleansing: Micellar Technology removes dirt and makeup effectively without stripping moisture.

Hydration & Protection: Clinically proven to provide continuous hydration and protect against dryness.

Skin Barrier Support: Enriched with Niacinamide, Vitamin B5, and Glycerin to reinforce the skin’s natural barrier.

Defends Against Skin Sensitivity: Protects against dryness, irritation, roughness, tightness, and weakened skin barrier.

Target Audience: Unisex Adults

Made in India

Ideal for daily cleansing to keep your skin hydrated, healthy, and comfortable.
